items.html:
Two actionable findings:

  • P2 — Restore reproducible reference provenance: bessel.rs:708 embeds six mpmath goldens. The explicit reference policy requires generated values in committed tables alongside their generator. Move the unchanged values into a small table, register its generator in generate_references.py, and read it through the existing test helper. The generator already contains the independent terminating-polynomial formula.
  • P3 — Remove redundant harmonic allocations: plan.rs:362 collects modes solely to read its length; use self.solids.len(). At line375, groups copy slices of g even though g remains alive throughout the fold. Borrow those slices and adjust the closure’s tuple type. This removes allocations without changing numerical operations or scheduling.

No additional actionable correctness or maintainability defects identified in the harmonic cache, independent batched GMRES, periodic caches, or S-matrix certificate. Their bounded state and retained reference paths serve concrete workload or numerical requirements; broader abstraction would add cost.

Read-only source review completed, including an independent S-matrix review. No edits, builds, or tests performed.
